tests.name: Hemoglobin
tests.low_meaning: A lower hemoglobin result may be associated with reduced oxygen-carrying capacity; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: A higher hemoglobin result can have several causes; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: WBC
tests.low_meaning: A lower white blood cell count may affect how the body responds to infection; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: A higher white blood cell count may occur for several reasons; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: RBC
tests.low_meaning: A lower red blood cell count may affect oxygen delivery; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: A higher red blood cell count can have several causes; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: Platelets
tests.low_meaning: A lower platelet count may affect blood clotting; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: A higher platelet count may have several causes; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: Glucose
tests.low_meaning: A lower glucose result may be important to review with your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: A higher glucose result may be important to review with your doctor.

tests.name: Cholesterol
tests.low_meaning: A lower total cholesterol result should be interpreted in context; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: A higher total cholesterol result may affect heart health; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: LDL
tests.low_meaning: A lower LDL result is usually interpreted with other health information; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: A higher LDL result may affect heart health; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: HDL
tests.low_meaning: A lower HDL result may affect heart health; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: A higher HDL result should be interpreted in context; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: Creatinine
tests.low_meaning: A lower creatinine result can have several explanations; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: A higher creatinine result may be related to kidney function; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: TSH
tests.low_meaning: A lower TSH result may relate to thyroid activity; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: A higher TSH result may relate to thyroid activity; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: HbA1c
tests.low_meaning: A lower HbA1c result should be interpreted in context; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: A higher HbA1c result may reflect higher average blood sugar; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: Bilirubin
tests.low_meaning: A lower total bilirubin result is typically not clinically significant; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: A higher bilirubin result may relate to liver function or red blood cell breakdown; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: SGPT / ALT
tests.low_meaning: A lower ALT result is generally normal; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: A higher ALT/SGPT result can indicate liver stress or inflammation; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: SGOT / AST
tests.low_meaning: A lower AST result is generally normal; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: A higher AST/SGOT result can indicate liver, heart, or muscle stress; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: Urea
tests.low_meaning: A lower blood urea result can relate to diet or hydration; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: A higher blood urea result may be related to kidney function or dehydration; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: Uric Acid
tests.low_meaning: A lower uric acid result is usually harmless; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: A higher uric acid result may relate to gout, kidney clearance, or joint inflammation; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: Triglycerides
tests.low_meaning: A lower triglyceride result is generally favorable; discuss with your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: Higher triglycerides may relate to metabolic or cardiovascular health; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: VLDL
tests.low_meaning: A lower VLDL result is generally favorable; discuss with your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: Higher VLDL may affect cardiovascular health; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: Alkaline Phosphatase
tests.low_meaning: A lower alkaline phosphatase result is uncommon; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: Higher alkaline phosphatase may relate to liver, gallbladder, or bone metabolism; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: Direct Bilirubin
tests.low_meaning: A low direct bilirubin level is generally normal; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: Higher direct bilirubin may be associated with liver clearance or bile flow; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: Total Protein
tests.low_meaning: Lower total protein can relate to nutritional balance, liver, or kidney function; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: Higher total protein can have several causes, including dehydration or inflammation; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: Albumin
tests.low_meaning: Lower albumin can reflect nutritional status, kidney filtration, or liver function; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: Higher albumin is typically associated with fluid loss or dehydration; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: eGFR
tests.low_meaning: A lower eGFR can suggest reduced kidney filtration efficiency; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: A normal or elevated eGFR indicates expected kidney filtration.

tests.name: Sodium
tests.low_meaning: Lower sodium (hyponatremia) affects body fluid and electrolyte balance; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: Higher sodium (hypernatremia) is commonly associated with fluid loss or dehydration; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: Potassium
tests.low_meaning: Lower potassium (hypokalemia) may affect muscle activity and heart rhythm; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: Higher potassium (hyperkalemia) can impact heart rhythm and kidney clearance; please consult your doctor promptly.

tests.name: Chloride
tests.low_meaning: Lower chloride can reflect electrolyte changes or fluid balance; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: Higher chloride can be related to dehydration or kidney regulation; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: Calcium
tests.low_meaning: Lower calcium may affect bone, nerve, or parathyroid balance; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: Higher calcium can relate to bone metabolism, parathyroid function, or hydration; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: ESR
tests.low_meaning: A low ESR reading is generally normal; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: An elevated ESR suggests possible inflammation or immune response; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: Vitamin D
tests.low_meaning: Lower vitamin D can affect bone density, calcium absorption, and energy; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: An elevated vitamin D level should be reviewed with your doctor or pharmacist.

tests.name: Vitamin B12
tests.low_meaning: Lower vitamin B12 may affect nerve function and red blood cell production; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: Elevated vitamin B12 should be reviewed in the context of supplements or clinical health.

tests.name: Free T4
tests.low_meaning: Lower Free T4 may relate to reduced thyroid hormone production; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: Higher Free T4 may reflect elevated thyroid hormone activity; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: Total T3
tests.low_meaning: Lower T3 can relate to thyroid hormone balance; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: Higher T3 can relate to thyroid hormone activity; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: Total T4
tests.low_meaning: Lower T4 may be associated with underactive thyroid function; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: Higher T4 may be associated with overactive thyroid function; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: Neutrophils
tests.low_meaning: Lower neutrophils (neutropenia) can affect the body's immune defense; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: Higher neutrophils may indicate an immune response or infection; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: Lymphocytes
tests.low_meaning: Lower lymphocytes may reflect temporary immune strain; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: Higher lymphocytes often reflect an immune response to viral or other challenges; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: Eosinophils
tests.low_meaning: A low eosinophil percentage is generally normal; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: Higher eosinophils can relate to allergic reactions or immune activity; please consult your doctor.

tests.name: Hematocrit
tests.low_meaning: Lower hematocrit may correspond to fewer red blood cells or lower hemoglobin; please consult your doctor.
tests.high_meaning: Higher hematocrit can relate to dehydration or elevated red cell volume; please consult your doctor.
